Name: Kitsutsune's Swans for BFAV
Author: Ciriun
Description:
Introducing Kitsutsune's Swans converted to work with BFAV! Graceful, majestic, and really just a nice thing to have around your farm. Don't worry, they're much nicer than the real thing.

Original version by Kitsutsune can be found here: [url=http://https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/swans-and-dodos-and-aptonoth.111758/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/swans-and-dodos-and-aptonoth.111758/[/url]

**Update 5/4/2020**
To celebrate finally getting my BFAV mods working (and also my birthday!) I'm having a Birthday Blue Birds Bash! This means there is an alternative version that has blue swans. I went for a very delicate baby blue because it seemed fitting and I don't see many pastel blue animals around. Just be sure to only use on version!
